name: codex-research-campaign
description: Durable state and handoffs for long-running Codex research, engineering, and other substantial campaigns.

interface.shortDescription: Track long-running research, engineering, and other substantial campaigns.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex campaign record for substantial work. It keeps campaign identity separate from phases, carries bounded work packages across sessions, and records receipts and parent decisions for reconciliation. It supports continuity without replacing the lead's responsibility to keep the whole campaign moving.
defaultPrompt: Open or resume a governed research or engineering campaign
Preflight a campaign before dispatching a work package
Review campaign receipts and next permitted actions
